question: When and where should the arghya offering be presented during the ritual sequence?
premises: The action occurs at the end of sipping water.
The application begins with the head.
Arghya is to be offered on the head.
inference: At the end of ācamana, arghya should be offered on the head, beginning from the head region.
plain_english: At the end of the sipping rite, one should offer arghya on the head, beginning with the head.
